Options:
  -s, --source SOURCE  Select a package source
  --packages DIRECTORY  Set package directory
  --configfile FILE  Select NuGet configuration
  --disable-parallel  Disable concurrent restores
  --ignore-failed-sources  Continue past unavailable sources
  --no-cache  Disable package HTTP caching
  --force  Resolve dependencies again
  --locked-mode  Require an unchanged lockfile
  --use-lock-file  Write a dependency lockfile
  -r, --runtime RUNTIME  Select runtime identifier
  -v, --verbosity LEVEL  Set logging detail
